summary: Replaced authority pattern-matching in src/security/detect/exfil.ts with real host RESOLUTION through the platform WHATWG URL parser against two synthetic bases that differ only in host, so a relative destination is identified by the disagreement between the two resolutions rather than by a syntax rule, and a destination naming a base host is not excused. Fixed extraction alongside classification: INLINE and REFERENCE_DEF gained an angle-bracket alternative so a CommonMark pointy-bracket destination reaches the classifier whole, and HTML_IMG / HTML_IMG_SRCSET now match the <image> spelling the HTML parser aliases to img. Added the HTML5 named references Tab and NewLine, plus bsol, which my own sweep found as a live sixth backslash spelling outside the reviewer's matrix. All 17 bypasses in the reviewer's 48-case matrix are closed with 0 false positives and all 20 previously fixed vectors holding, verified at the MCP dispatch and the persistence materializer with advisory redaction disabled, not only at the detector.

changed_files.change: exfilHost replaced by resolution through the platform URL parser against two synthetic bases (relative destinations identified by resolution disagreement, non-http(s) schemes and empty hosts rejected); NAMED_CHARACTER_REFERENCES gained tab, newline and bsol under a stated membership rule; INLINE and REFERENCE_DEF gained angle-bracket destination alternatives so a pointy-bracket destination is not truncated before classification; HTML_IMG and HTML_IMG_SRCSET match as well as ; header and inline comments record why recognition was replaced by resolution and what the synthetic base implies. Masking offsets untouched.

Added 8 tests: one regression per bypass class (backslash authority spellings incl. \, \ and \; extra slash runs; the HTML5 Tab/NewLine named references; the image tag alias; untruncated angle-bracket destinations), one benign-control test (14 controls incl. a public link with a backslash in its path, a relative backslash path, legitimate multi-candidate srcsets, relative angle destinations, data:/blob:/anchor/query destinations), and two boundary regressions driving prepareOutputForPersistence and validateOutputForTransport over one vector per class. No existing test weakened or removed.
